topic: Barry's original shifted Hankel conjecture, its parameter family and combinatorial source
title: Barry's shifted Hankel conjecture and an extension of Cigler's formula

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Paul Barry's shifted Hankel conjecture in OEIS A188475, revision 2 (April 1, 2011): for every n>=0, det[q(i+j+2)]_(0<=i,j<=n)=(2n^3+3n^2+n+3)/3, by a moment-matrix cofactor argument extending Cigler's unit-descent formula (2011, Theorem A*). The same calculation gives both adjacent shifts and a parameter formula det[q_lambda(i+j+2)]_(i,j<N)=1+lambda*sum(k^2,k=0..N-1) for every complex lambda, with q_lambda defined by its Catalan generating function. A direct bijection relates the source's nonexchangeable subsequences to Callan's restricted Grand Dyck paths.
summary: A complete cofactor proof, a one-parameter extension, adjacent shifts, exact normalization, and a direct combinatorial correspondence. Prior-work verdict: unclear (Mu-Wang overlap unresolved). Lili Mu and Yi Wang, Hankel determinants of shifted Catalan-like numbers, Discrete Mathematics 340(6) (2017), 1389-1396, doi:10.1016/j.disc.2016.09.035, is closely related work whose relationship to the cubic identity remains unresolved. Overlap is not excluded. No priority claim is made.
